Three persons suffered serious injuries after a speeding car hit them and sped away in Otteri on Friday night.
A senior official of the City Traffic police said M. Thaufiq was standing outside a medical shop after buying medicines for his family in Rettamalai Sreenivasan street in Otteri when a speeding vehicle lost control and hit him. Two pedestrians who have been identified as Sasikala and Anbarasi were also injured. The car driver fled from the scene.
The residents of the street rushed the three injured victims to the Government Kilpauk medical college hospital for treatment.
The Kilpauk Traffic investigation police have filed a case and are searching for the driver of the car.
